assumptions: Substrate thickness set to 2 um; the paper does not state it, and the 100 nm ground plane makes it optically irrelevant.
Source spectral range 4-8.5 um chosen to cover the 6 um peak; the paper plots 3-11 um / measures 3-12 um.
Cross arms modelled as two overlapping boxes (plus sign), matching Fig. 1(a).
Custom materials named Au_paper / Al2O3_paper to avoid collision with built-in database entries.
Si substrate uses the built-in 'Si (Silicon) - Palik' entry; the paper only says 'silicon substrate'.
